newsitem.title: UK: Ascot transformation on track, resumes div.
newsitem.headline: Ascot transformation on track, resumes div.

text.p: British diversified industrial and services company Ascot Holdings Plc said on Monday that its ongoing transformation following its purchase in August this year of Suter Plc was progressing in line with its expectations.
In line with a promise when it offered for Suter, Ascot proposed a final dividend within its interim results announced during the day -- its first to be paid since November 1991.

"I am pleased to report that the transformation of your company from a property and leisure business to a manufacturing- based business with good prospects has been achieved this year," company chairman and chief executive Howard Dyer said.
